purpose: Route ordinary, frightened reader language to quarantined records while preventing diagnosis, countdowns, legal advice, funeral/disposition advice, autopsy/donation advice, procedure-level instruction, prophecy, or harmful detail.
routing_policy: Match the reader phrase to records.
Show safety interstitial before record text.
Never infer diagnosis, prognosis, legal duty, or cultural meaning from a query.
Prefer “what has been witnessed” over “what you should do.”
